description: Standard template for integrating with an external REST API backend

tasks.title: Analyze API specification
tasks.notes: Adjust upward if spec is undocumented or incomplete. Add 2 days if no swagger/openapi doc exists.

tasks.title: Set up authentication layer
tasks.notes: OAuth2 flows add ~2 days. API key auth is baseline. SAML adds ~4 days.

tasks.title: Build REST client wrapper
tasks.notes: Includes retry logic, timeout handling, basic error mapping.

tasks.title: Implement error handling and logging
tasks.notes: Map API error codes to internal error types. Add structured logging.

tasks.title: Write unit tests with mocked responses
tasks.notes: Mock all external calls. Target 80% coverage minimum.

tasks.title: Write integration tests against staging API
tasks.notes: Requires staging environment access. Flag dependency on external team for staging credentials.

tasks.title: Network and firewall configuration
tasks.notes: External dependency — network team. Raise change request early. Often causes slip.

tasks.title: Deploy to staging and smoke test
tasks.notes: Gate on network config being complete.

tasks.title: Deploy to production
tasks.notes: Requires signed off smoke test results and change approval board approval.

calibration_history.note: Increased analyze-spec baseline from 2 to 3 days based on AUTH and BILLING project actuals
Added network-config as explicit task after it caused untracked slip in 3 consecutive projects
